lines: List every locked reference here: file name, what it controls, and the date it was approved.

placement.reason: unreviewed generator output, approved by moving it out

purpose: `{{project}}` is a video production workspace. Build reusable assets first (sets, characters, details), then direct shots from them.
rules: - Read `assets/canon/CANON.md` at the start of every task.
- Never read, reference, or source anything from `archive/`.
- New generator output goes in `assets/generated/` or `renders/`. Move a file to `assets/approved/` only when the owner approves it. A file named `final` or the newest file is not approval.
- Before generating or editing, state the asset's role: environment plate, character reference, detail or prop reference, shot reference, or finished shot. Do not silently turn one role into another.
- Always pass the required reference images to the generator. Do not generate a canon subject from a text prompt alone.
- Save each candidate with its exact prompt and the list of references used, in `prompts/`.
- One review item at a time: make only the requested change, show it, and wait for direction.
- A deliverable is a new folder `deliverables/<Title>-rNN`. Never edit a delivered folder; make the next revision number.
- `footage/raw/` is read-only. Work on copies in `footage/proxies/`.
- For packaging or review requests, assemble existing files. Do not generate or fix artwork unless asked.
